entities.summary:
The Mozilla Foundation is an American non-profit founded in 2003 in San Francisco to steward open-source internet projects descending from Netscape’s Mozilla code, most famously the Firefox browser. It pairs public-interest governance with a taxable subsidiary for product revenue.

Firefox’s mid-2000s challenge to Internet Explorer revived browser competition and popularised extensions, privacy branding, and open-web standards advocacy. Later mobile and search-deal economics tested the Foundation’s sustainability model.

Mozilla became the institutional face of a civic open-web counterweight to proprietary platform browsers.
